name: Luna Has Gone
storyline:
On their way to Earth, a commercial spaceship was hijacked by pirates. Misha managed to escape, but her best friend Luna’s fate remains unknown. After the hijacking, Misha ended up in City 221 with the help of a local bar owner.

Her future now rests in your hands. Will she find her friend, or will something unexpected happen? The choice is in your hands.
summary: Luna Has Gone is an RPG inspired by PS1-era pre-rendered backgrounds, delivering a unique visual style for an RPG Maker game. The gameplay features turn-based battles with limited resources. You play as Misha, the daughter of a world-class corporation, whose goal is to find her missing friend, Luna.
